name: Watkins Glen International
hoursNote: Drive The Glen paced laps ($25/vehicle, 3 laps) available Apr–Oct, Mon–Fri; closed Sat–Sun except on event days. Schedule varies around race events—confirm at theglen.com or call ahead.
description: Watkins Glen International is a legendary 3.4-mile road-course race track in the Finger Lakes. Visitors can drive their own car around the full circuit via the Drive The Glen experience ($25/vehicle, 3 paced laps, Mon–Fri Apr–Oct). The track hosts NASCAR, IMSA, and vintage racing events throughout the season and offers grandstand viewing for ticketed race weekends.

name: F.L.X. Summer Fest at The Glen
Fly-in / Drive-in Breakfast
address: Penn Yan Airport, 2258 Airport Dr, Penn Yan, NY 14527
description: Penn Yan Flying Club's annual July 4 fly-in/drive-in breakfast at Penn Yan Airport — 2026 marks the 85th year of this tradition. Features Birkett Mills buckwheat pancakes, airplane and helicopter rides, bounce house, live music, raffles, and family activities. Open to all — fly, drive, or bike in.
